data.title: 芙宁娜 · 独奏沙龙午后茶歇
data.description: 午后阳光穿过沙龙的落地窗，留声机旁的茶桌上摆着草莓蛋糕。芙宁娜戴着黑色贝雷帽，身穿深蓝开衫侧坐在雕花扶手椅上，一手托茶碟，另一手把骨瓷杯停在唇边。她的视线追着茶桌上方轻轻跃动的一只小水形幻灵，忍不住笑了起来，连刚才想好的开场白也忘掉了。
data.location: 枫丹私人公寓阳光沙龙
data.action: 侧坐扶手椅，一手托茶碟，一手端杯停在唇边，微笑注视茶桌上方的小水形幻灵。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, tea table included
data.promptProse: A small water spirit bobs above the tea table beside the strawberry cake, drawing Furina into an unguarded smile. She sits sideways in the carved armchair wearing her navy cardigan and black beret. One hand supports the saucer while the other pauses with the iris-patterned cup at her lips. Broad afternoon window light reaches the tiny floating creature, porcelain and nearby gramophone. The spirit is a small nonhuman companion; Furina remains the only person in the salon.
